verdict.rationale: Ramp documents issuing virtual cards with per-vendor spending limits. Its MCP server exposes limits:write, cards:write and spend_programs scopes, which implies limits are managed programmatically, and a user reports spinning up a new expense card in under a minute. Explicit per-employee limits and granular controls (category, merchant, time-window restrictions per person) are not described; the only detailed per-merchant and expiry restrictions apply to agent cards, not employees. Missing for 10: documented per-employee card limit configuration, granular employee-level controls (merchant/category/time restrictions), independent corroboration of limit controls.
